about.heading: The In Step Difference
about.description: For nearly 30 years, In Step has been a beacon of hope in our community, providing comprehensive mental health services with a focus on inclusion, healing, and empowerment.
storyParagraphs: Founded with the vision of walking alongside individuals on their mental health journey, In Step has grown from a small practice to a comprehensive community mental health center serving diverse populations with specialized care.

We specialize in offering a wide range of group treatments including our renowned DBT skills groups, Stepping Stones social skills for children and teens, and innovative programs for reentry support and domestic violence survivors.

Our team takes special care to match individuals with appropriate support chronologically, developmentally, and emotionally, ensuring that every person receives the most effective and personalized care possible.

values.title: Compassionate Care
values.description: We believe in treating every individual with dignity, respect, and genuine empathy throughout their healing journey.

values.title: Community Focused
values.description: Our programs are designed to strengthen the entire community, creating lasting positive change for all.

values.title: Safe & Inclusive
values.description: We provide a safe, welcoming environment where everyone feels valued regardless of their background or circumstances.

values.title: Evidence-Based
values.description: All our interventions are grounded in research and proven therapeutic approaches for maximum effectiveness.

cta.heading: Join Our Community of Healing
cta.description: Experience the In Step difference for yourself. Our compassionate team is ready to walk alongside you on your journey toward mental wellness and personal growth.

services.heading: Our Services
services.description: We specialize in offering a wide range of individual and group treatments, taking special care to match individuals with the appropriate support chronologically, developmentally, and emotionally.

items.title: Individual Therapy
items.description: Individual therapy provides a safe space to unpack your thoughts, explore your feelings, and work through challenges one-on-one with an experienced clinician.
items.alt: Professional mental health counselor having a one-on-one session with a client in a comfortable office setting

items.title: Group Therapy
items.description: Group therapy provides a platform for children, teens, and adults to cultivate healthy relationships, navigate challenges, and hone new skills within a nurturing environment.
items.alt: Diverse group of people in a supportive group therapy session sitting in a circle

items.title: Family Therapy
items.description: Family therapy paves the way for peace at home by strengthening bonds, resolving conflicts, and establishing healthy boundaries.
items.alt: Happy diverse family with parents and children in a warm, supportive therapy environment

items.title: Psychological Testing
items.description: Psycho-educational testing offers valuable insights into the roots of challenges, supplying essential data to guide therapeutic and educational interventions effectively.
items.alt: Professional assessment and testing environment for psychological evaluation

cta.heading: Ready to Take the First Step?
cta.description: Our experienced team is here to support you on your mental health journey. Contact us today to learn more about our services and how we can help.

programs.heading: Community Programs
programs.description: Beyond traditional therapy, we offer specialized community programs designed to support individuals and families facing unique challenges and transitions.

items.title: Reentry Support Program
items.description: Comprehensive support for individuals transitioning back into the community, including counseling, life skills training, and resource connection.

items.title: Domestic Violence Support
items.description: Safe, confidential support for survivors of domestic violence with trauma-informed care and empowerment-focused interventions.

items.title: DBT Skills Groups
items.description: Dialectical Behavior Therapy skills training in a supportive group environment, focusing on mindfulness, emotion regulation, and interpersonal effectiveness.

items.title: Stepping Stones (Youth)
items.description: Social skills development for children and teens, focusing on building healthy relationships and emotional intelligence.

items.title: Parenting Skills Program
items.description: Evidence-based parenting education and support to strengthen family relationships and improve communication.

items.title: Community Workshops
items.description: Educational workshops on mental health topics, stress management, and wellness strategies for community members.

crisisBanner.heading: Crisis Support Available 24/7
crisisBanner.description: If you or someone you know is in crisis or experiencing domestic violence, immediate help is available. Don't wait – reach out now.

testimonials.heading: Stories of Hope & Healing
testimonials.description: Hear from real people whose lives have been transformed through our programs and services. Your story of healing could be next.

items.name: Sarah M.
items.content: The DBT skills group at In Step changed my life. I learned how to manage my emotions and build healthier relationships. The group was so supportive and the facilitators were amazing.

items.name: Michael R.
items.content: Coming back to the community was scary, but the reentry program gave me the tools and support I needed. They helped me find housing, employment, and most importantly, hope for the future.

items.name: Jennifer L.
items.content: Our family was struggling to communicate, but through family therapy at In Step, we learned to listen to each other and work through our problems together. We're stronger than ever now.

items.name: David K.
items.content: After years of struggling with anxiety and depression, I finally found the right therapist at In Step. The individual attention and evidence-based approach made all the difference.

items.name: Maria S.
items.content: The support I received after leaving an abusive relationship was incredible. The staff understood my trauma and helped me rebuild my confidence and sense of safety. I'm forever grateful.

items.name: James T.
items.content: The parenting program taught me how to set boundaries while showing love and support. My relationship with my teenager has improved dramatically. Highly recommend to any parent struggling.

team.heading: Our Team
team.description: Meet our dedicated team of licensed professionals who are committed to providing compassionate, evidence-based mental health care to our community.

members.name: Cathi Cohen
members.title: Founder & Clinical Director
members.bio: In Step's Founder and Clinical Director is a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) and Certified Group Psychotherapist (CGP). She has worked with children, adolescents, and adults in a clinical setting since 1984.

members.name: Dale Sorg
members.title: Licensed School Psychologist
members.bio: Dale is passionate about promoting age-appropriate growth and development and supporting families during the critical early years of childhood.
education: Ed.S School Psychology - James Madison University
M.A. School Psychology - James Madison University

members.name: Erika Carlson
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio: Erika offers treatment and support to adolescents and adults who present with various mental health issues, including depression, anxiety, and personality disorders.

members.name: Christina Marcone
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio: Christina's therapeutic approach is grounded in empathy, understanding, and a strong commitment to helping clients reach their highest potential.

members.name: Jim Sebben
members.title: Licensed Professional Counselor & Marriage and Family Therapist
members.bio: Jim has been in private practice since 1986. His goal is to collaborate with clients to help them define their values, examine their emotions and set attainable goals.

members.name: Kimberley Grimes
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio: Kimberley specializes in working one-on-one and in groups with children, adolescents, and their families. She has a profound belief in the inherent strength and propensity for growth of the family.
education: M.A. Human Development - University of Illinois

members.name: Dov Cohen
members.title: Social Worker
members.bio: Dov is a compassionate therapist with a knack for connecting with kids, teens, young adults, and parents. He developed the unique Dungeon and Dragons therapy program.
education: B.A. Psychology - The College of Wooster

members.name: Kelly Murphy
members.title: Licensed Professional Counselor
members.bio: Kelly provides a wide range of services to teens, families, and children. Her particular area of interest is treating children and teens with behavioral challenges and anxiety.
education: M.A. Education and Human Development - George Washington University

members.name: Salima Jiwa
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio: Salima is passionate about coaching clients to utilize their own well-being and innate wisdom in resolving their struggles. She is trained in the three principles approach.

members.name: Rachel Cherian
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio: Rachel has over 20 years of clinical experience. Growing up as an Indian-American gives her unique ability to understand the perspective of both teens and parents in the process of acculturation.

members.name: Keith K. Ewell
members.title: Licensed Clinical Psychologist
members.bio: Keith has been with In Step for over 20 years. He has a passion for working with teenagers who are struggling with anxiety disorders, depression, and ADHD.

members.name: Erica Craig-Mann
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker & Drama Therapist
members.bio: Erica uses talk therapy, creative expression, and embodied techniques to help people navigate life's messy challenges. She is an LGBTQ+ affirming therapist.
education: Ph.D. Counseling Education - Antioch University (in progress)

members.name: Zara Ahmad
members.title: Nationally Certified School Psychologist
members.bio: Zara creates a safe space for kids and teens to grow and change. With a gift for connecting with children on a personal level, she especially enjoys working with folks on the spectrum.
education: M.A. School Psychology - George Mason University

members.name: Jennifer Case
members.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker
members.bio: Jennifer is a compassionate clinician dedicated to supporting children, teens, and families through life's challenges.

members.name: Mary Shuffleton
members.title: Clinical Therapist
members.bio: Mary brings compassion and expertise to her work with clients seeking mental health support and personal growth.
